page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m2s.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz. It features 4 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, 8.0 GB of system memory providing 2.0 GB per core, and a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU allocation of 0.0833 with 2 GB of VRAM. The instance does not include local storage and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results show average performance in single-core operations, with a stress-ng single-core score of 1884.98 and a Geekbench single-core score of 1595.0. However, multi-core performance is weak, as indicated by a stress-ng multi-core score of 5733.3 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 4061.0. Memory performance is mixed; while small-block cached read bandwidth is average at 421.08 GB/sec, the PassMark memory score is poor at 1096.88. For specialized workloads, the fractional GPU enables average performance in small-scale LLM inference, achieving 117.31 tokens/sec for text generation on a 135M model, but drops to a poor 4.57 tokens/sec on a 7B model.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers an entry-level entry point to GPU-accelerated resources by utilizing a fractional GPU slice rather than a full dedicated accelerator, reducing the cost overhead for workloads that do not require massive VRAM. Tradeoffs include the lack of local storage and weak multi-threaded CPU scaling. This profile is suitable for lightweight GPU-accelerated tasks, basic virtual workstations, small-scale model inference, and general-purpose tasks requiring minor hardware acceleration.
